name: Sandbox Untrusted Scripts
description: Detects and warns when executing scripts downloaded from the internet or piped from curl/wget to prevent supply chain attacks
content:
#!/bin/bash
# Detect piped script execution patterns
COMMAND="$TOOL_INPUT_COMMAND"
# Block curl | sh patterns
if echo "$COMMAND" | grep -qE '(curl|wget)\s+.*\|\s*(bash|sh|zsh|source)'; then
  echo "BLOCKED: Piping remote scripts directly to shell is dangerous. Download first, review, then execute."
  exit 2
fi
# Warn on executing recently downloaded scripts
if echo "$COMMAND" | grep -qE '(bash|sh|zsh|source)\s+/tmp/'; then
  echo "WARNING: Executing script from /tmp directory. Ensure this script has been reviewed."
  exit 2
fi
exit 0
